subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】face 脸; ear 耳朵; eye 眼睛; nose 鼻子; mouth 嘴巴; arm 胳膊; hand 手; head 头; body 身体; leg 腿; foot 脚; school 学校
【重点句型】How are you? 你好吗？ I'm fine, thank you. 我很好，谢谢。 Look at me! 看我！ This is the ... 这是…… Very well, thanks. 很好，谢谢。
【A Let's talk】Wu Yifan: How are you, Sarah? Sarah: I'm fine, thank you. Wu Yifan: Very well, thanks. Sarah: Look at my nose! Wu Yifan: Look at my eye!
【Read and write】Look at me! This is my face. This is my nose. This is my mouth. This is my ear. This is my eye. This is my head. This is my body. This is my arm. This is my hand. This is my leg. This is my foot.
key_points: I'm fine, thank you. 我很好，谢谢。
Very well, thanks. 很好，谢谢。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
